ambiguity: GLOSS.ally gap: 'your friend' has no game state
ruling: A creature whose attitude toward the party is Friendly (the GLOSS.influence attitudes) is the party's friend and so its ally, even if it isn't fighting on a side. An Indifferent or Hostile creature isn't a friend.
note: 'Your friend' is a Friendly attitude toward that PC; the GM can designate otherwise (T-90).
